header.title: Featured Projects
header.subtitle: Enterprise experience and scalable systems architecture

items.title: Elevator Ecosystem Monorepo
description: Enterprise-grade hybrid architecture integrating a Next.js customer web portal, FastAPI core backend, and an offline-first Flutter application for field technicians.
Strict Clean Architecture implementation with BLoC state management and FIFO offline queue synchronization.
Centralized single source of truth database with PostgreSQL and role-based access control (RBAC).

items.title: IoT Elevator Telemetry
description: Hardware-to-Cloud telemetry system utilizing C++ (Arduino Edge Node) for high-speed signal extraction via bit-masking, broadcasting real-time faults via MQTT and WebSockets with sub-50ms latency.
Industrial edge node firmware with hardware watchdogs and non-blocking I/O routines.
Comprehensive hardware circuit design and virtual simulation verified within Proteus VSM.

items.title: TaskFlow Workspace
description: High-performance reactive task management mobile application engineered with Flutter and Dart, featuring local backend logic, SQLite persistence, and robust BLoC state management.
Fluid gesture-driven user interface with custom animations, dark/light dynamic theming, and responsive layouts.
Optimized relational database schema ensuring instant query execution and zero frame drops.
